strategy_roster.name: IMA Expert
strategy_roster.notes: ROC of close/SMA(5) directly proxies the one-bar relative change in IMA and uses the documented 0.5 threshold. Tick protection and volume sizing are not percentage exit rules.

strategy_roster.name: SuperATR 7-Step Profit
strategy_roster.entry_long: atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),14) and close > sma(close,10) and sma(close,10) > sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.exit_long: atr(high,low,close,14) < sma(atr(high,low,close,14),14) or close < sma(close,10) or sma(close,10) < sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: ATR(14) expansion and SMA 10/50 are explicit fallbacks because no periods or thresholds are supplied. The seven staged ATR/percentage exits and partial-position accounting are not supported by the roster.

strategy_roster.name: Reversal Catcher
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(rsi(close,14),30) and low <= bb_lower(close,20,1.5) and close > ema(close,21) and ema(close,21) > ema(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14), Bollinger(20,1.5), and EMA 21/50 retain the stated oversold re-entry and trend structure. Prior-candle stop/target and the 15:00 flatten require bar-shift or clock state.

strategy_roster.name: Reversal & Breakout Strategy with ORB
strategy_roster.notes: EMA 9/21 with RSI 50/40 is an explicit fallback for the documented but underspecified EMA-breakout component. The SMA reversal, ORB clock range, and ATR targets/stops are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: RangeBreakout2
strategy_roster.notes: The prior 20-bar high plus 50% of ATR(20) retains the default ATR range breakout. Schedule, range restart, martingale/Fibonacci sizing, and range-derived exits require state.

strategy_roster.name: CandleStop Trailing
strategy_roster.notes: This is an exit/trailing manager for manual or externally opened trades, not an entry strategy, so an impossible negative-price guard preserves that limitation. Donchian trailing cannot create a long signal.

strategy_roster.name: ZigZag EvgeTrofi
strategy_roster.notes: The documented contrarian new-high trigger uses a prior 17-bar high; the mean band is an exit proxy. Point deviation, backstep, urgency, and persistent pivot state are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Otkat Sys
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish candle within a negative three-bar move is a single-timeframe proxy for the prior-session reversal. Daily statistics, corridor thresholds, Tuesday-Thursday 00:00-00:03 timing, and point exits are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Parabolic SAR Fibo Limits
strategy_roster.notes: Aligned EMA(10)/EMA(20) replaces dual SAR direction and a touch of the fast line approximates a Fibonacci limit entry. Swing/Fibonacci levels, session timing, break-even, trailing, and point protection are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Rsi Test
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing above the documented oversold level 12 plus a bullish candle is an explicit momentum/candle proxy. The exact fast filter, risk sizing, position cap, and step-based trailing are unavailable.
